revision_2_note: REV 1 CALLED THESE 'GHOSTS FROM AN OLD ROSTER'. THAT WAS WRONG IN MECHANISM. fleet_probe_log carries HTTP status per probe, and it shows every one of the 22 returned HTTP 200 (113-395 times each) until 2026-09-11, then flipped to 404. They were LIVE workers deleted in the consolidation wave; the rosters were simply never updated. The 55-worker baseline is CONFIRMED authoritative by this evidence, which resolves the largest uncertainty in rev 1.
